note: Three items from one family transform Isaac. The family tags come from the game's own item metadata, not from a list typed here. Two real transformations are unreachable in this data: only one item carries the bob tag and two carry devil, so Bob and Leviathan can never complete.

transformations.name: Guppy
transformations.note: Flight, and every hit you take throws out blue flies that fight for you.

transformations.name: Beelzebub
transformations.note: Flight, and the flies already orbiting you stop being decoration.

transformations.name: Seraphim
transformations.note: Flight and a soul heart. Angel rooms stop being a detour and start being a plan.

transformations.name: Fun Guy
transformations.note: A heart container and a heal. Quietly one of the better ones to stumble into.

transformations.name: Spun
transformations.note: Speed, damage and rate together, plus a pill every floor.

transformations.name: Yes Mother?
transformations.note: Straight damage and rate. No trick to it, and none needed.

transformations.name: Conjoined
transformations.note: Two extra heads firing alongside you, covering angles you are not aiming at.

transformations.name: Spider Baby
transformations.note: Blue spiders spawn every time you are hit, so taking damage buys you something.

transformations.name: Book Worm
transformations.note: Every book fires twice. Worth more the more actives you were already carrying.

transformations.name: Poop
transformations.note: The least glamorous transformation in the game. It is still three free stat points.
